introHeader: Fill out this form to apply for Chief Minister (CM) and Noble Advisor (NA) appointments.
introRequirements:
Requirements:

- Form must be filled out in order to be considered for an appointment during KvK preparation week.
- Form must be filled out by THE SUNDAY OF MATCHMAKING.
- Form filled out after the deadline will be added to the "Late" submission wait list.
- Rally leaders and rally leader substitutes may be given priority (if necessary).
- Verification of items, speedups, and resources may be requested (an example could be during situations where the score is very close in points and to make sure our kingdom wins by ensuring appointments go to players who can maximize points).
introMoreInfo:
For more information:
- Contact form support: {{support}} if you have questions on filling out this form or changes to your form submission!
